item.title: Rob Pike's 5 Rules of Programming
item.description:
📝 Pike's rules 1 and 2 restate Tony Hoare's famous maxim "Premature optimization is the root of all evil. " Ken Thompson rephrased Pike's rules 3 and 4 as "When in doubt, use brute force. Rule 5 is often shortened to "write stupid code that uses smart objects".
🔗 Read more: https://www.cs.unc.edu/~stotts/COMP590-059-f24/robsrules.html

item.title: Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework
item.description:
📝 Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework Mar 17, 2026 · Share x. Their new paper, "Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Taxonomy," presents a framework for understanding AI systems' cognitive capabilities. Deconstructing general intelligenceOur framework draws on decades of research from psychology, neuroscience and cognitive science to develop a cognitive taxonomy.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/measuring-agi-cognitive-framework/
